host_toolchain.rationale: MSVC cl.exe lacks __attribute__((sysv_abi)); NDK ships no lld-link.

guest_toolchain._current_ndk_fixture_note: One ELF fixture (libreloc_ndk_current.so) is built by host_toolchain.ndk_for_host_clang at this API level with no packing flags, to capture what a current NDK emits by default. Measured: NDK 29 adds --pack-dyn-relocs=relr --use-android-relr-tags at API >= 28; NDK 27 does not.

fixture_toolchain._public_ids_note: The framework resource package pins every PUBLIC resource id of this platform jar (tools/build-framework-res.ps1), so apps compiled against any SDK up to it resolve @android: references.
fixture_toolchain.note: JDK and Android SDK are BUILD-time only. The shipped runner must not need them.

_note_paths: All paths use forward slashes; they are valid for Win32 APIs and CMake.
